OUR STORY

Roasted With Passion, Served With Pride

Ambrosia began with a simple belief — that great coffee starts with great beans, and great beans deserve careful hands. We work directly with small farms to source single-origin and signature blends, then roast each batch in small quantities to lock in flavour and freshness.

From our roastery to your cup, every step is done with care — because coffee isn't just a drink for us, it's a craft.

10+Years Roasting
25+Partner Farms
50k+Cups Served
